name: heatmap-chart
title: HeatmapChart
description: Input is week columns containing dated bins, not a numeric matrix or an automatic aggregation. weekStartDay rotates display rows without changing date identity. Default fluid layout, 2px gaps, 2px corners and 1600ms entrance. Thresholds remain <=0, 1, 2, 3, >=4; shades derive from chart-1 and muted. Pass the same levelStyles to cells/chart and external legend. Every instance owns its texture IDs.
